description: A mirror post: the analyst re-uploads a Telegram channel's clip, links the t.me post and writes no coordinate. Nothing is detected on any entry (coords_missing), and the engine's second exit carries a request draft: the source is the chased t.me post, its date comes from the embed, and the footage is the video the embed served. embed.html is what the chase reads.
